package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"text/template"
)

type Msg struct {
	Role      string
	Content   string
	ToolCalls []string
}

func collate(in []Msg) (string, []*Msg) {
	var sys []string
	var out []*Msg
	for i := range in {
		if in[i].Role == "system" {
			sys = append(sys, in[i].Content)
		}
		if len(out) > 0 && out[len(out)-1].Role == in[i].Role {
			out[len(out)-1].Content += "\n\n" + in[i].Content
			continue
		}
		m := in[i]
		out = append(out, &m)
	}
	return strings.Join(sys, "\n\n"), out
}

func main() {
	b, _ := os.ReadFile("template.txt")
	t := template.Must(template.New("t").Parse(string(b)))
	cases := map[string][]Msg{
		"system_user":            {{Role: "system", Content: "SYS line one.\nLine two."}, {Role: "user", Content: "{\"venue\": \"bar\"}"}},
		"user_only":              {{Role: "user", Content: "hi"}},
		"system_user_assistant":  {{Role: "system", Content: "SYS"}, {Role: "user", Content: "U1"}, {Role: "assistant", Content: "A1"}},
		"system_user_asst_user":  {{Role: "system", Content: "SYS"}, {Role: "user", Content: "U1"}, {Role: "assistant", Content: "A1"}, {Role: "user", Content: "U2"}},
	}
	out := map[string]string{}
	for k, msgs := range cases {
		sys, ms := collate(msgs)
		var sb strings.Builder
		err := t.Execute(&sb, map[string]any{"System": sys, "Messages": ms, "Tools": []string(nil), "Response": ""})
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		out[k] = sb.String()
	}
	j, _ := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", "  ")
	fmt.Println(string(j))
}
